blocking_inconsistencies.description: The lump-sum budget response directory docs/integrations/lump_sum_budget_planner/received/ contains no budget response file (only a .gitkeep placeholder is present). No budget response was received through the integration channel. Absent budget artifacts constitute a blocking gate failure, not a hold or pending state, per CLAUDE.md Section 8.4 and Section 13.4. No structural WP or partner coverage check could be performed because no response exists to validate against wp_structure.json.
blocking_inconsistencies.resolution_note: A validated budget response must be received in docs/integrations/lump_sum_budget_planner/received/ and pass interface-contract conformance and structural-consistency validation before this gate can be re-evaluated. This skill validates the lump-sum interface channel only and does not compute, estimate, or substitute any budget figure. Phase 8 remains fully blocked (CLAUDE.md Section 8.4) until gate_09 confirms a complete, structurally consistent budget.
